description: This file contains unit tests for the DeleteAttributesStrategy class, which tests the behavior of deleting attributes from a 'Thing' within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It verifies immutability, successful deletion of attributes, and error handling when attributes are absent.

classes.name: DeleteAttributesStrategyTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DeleteAttributesStrategy, testing immutability, successful attribute deletion, and handling of missing attributes.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the DeleteAttributesStrategy instance before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the DeleteAttributesStrategy class is immutable.

methods.name: successfullyDeleteAllAttributesFromThing
methods.description: Tests successful deletion of all attributes from a Thing object.

methods.name: deleteAttributesFromThingWithoutAttributes
methods.description: Tests error handling when attempting to delete attributes from a Thing that has no attributes.
